svg.title: Distance between fringes on a screen
svg.desc: Two slits a distance d apart are a distance x from a screen. A line at angle θ from the slits reaches the screen a distance y from its center, forming a right triangle with the horizontal line x. For small angles the distance between adjacent fringes is Δy = xλ/d. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Fringe spacing responds to one parameter at a time
Each stage holds the other parameters fixed. Fraunhofer, small-angle, narrow-slit model; wavelength
changes do not represent a single traveling wave changing color.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
